How to get a rank

Three steps, about a minute — same steps for VIP and every Kage tier.

STEP 1

You're already here

Type /vip in-game any time to come back to this page and check the price and perks.

STEP 2

Message the owner in-game

Ask for the owner in chat and name the rank you want — VIP ($20), Kage+ ($4.99), Kage++ ($9.99) or Kage+++ ($14.99). The owner confirms that rank's price in real money and tells you how to pay. Don't pay anyone else.

STEP 3

Pay, get 30 days

Pay the way the owner directed and give your exact Minecraft username. Your rank turns on for that account for 30 days — and if it's VIP, the $10,000,000 in-game money is added to your balance too. Pay again next month only if you want to keep the rank.

Questions

The stuff players ask before they buy.

How much is VIP, exactly?

$20 per month, in real money (USD). Each payment gives you 30 days of VIP starting when the rank is activated on your account.

What's the difference between VIP and Kage+, Kage++ and Kage+++?

VIP ($20/mo) is the top rank: $10,000,000 in-game money, 200 homes, the gold [VIP] tag, priority join, and /enderchest and /craft anywhere. The Kage tiers are lighter ranks priced by homes and auction slots — Kage+ ($4.99/mo) gives 9 homes and 45 auction slots, Kage++ ($9.99/mo) gives 27 homes and 90 auction slots, and Kage+++ ($14.99/mo) gives 90 homes and 90 auction slots. Every rank lasts 30 days per payment.

Does it auto-renew or charge me again?

No — that goes for VIP and every Kage tier. There's no automatic charge. When your 30 days run out, your rank simply expires — pay again only if you want another 30 days.

How do I get the $10M in-game money?

It's included with VIP. When your rank is activated, $10,000,000 in-game money is added to your balance — type /bal in-game to see it. Spend it in the shop and auction house like any other server money. It's in-game money only, not real money.

Does VIP give gear or win duels for me?

No. VIP does not hand you weapons, armour, or an Elytra, and it doesn't change duel outcomes. You get the $10M in-game money, convenience (200 homes, /ec, /craft), priority joining, and the gold tag. The shop, auction house, jobs, and RTP work the same for everyone.

What happens to my extra homes when VIP expires?

Your homes aren't deleted. You just can't set new ones beyond the free limit of 3 until you're back under the limit or you renew VIP.

I paid — why don't I have VIP yet?

VIP is added to one exact username. Check that the owner has the correct spelling (letters, numbers, and underscores all matter), then rejoin the server so the rank refreshes.

Not on the server yet?

Join Kage SMP, look around spawn, try /shop, /jobs, and /rtp for free — then run /vip in-game whenever you're ready.
